player_prompt.intro:
Welcome to Nim, Player {player_id}!
Rules:
- On your turn, remove at least one object from exactly one pile.
- Remove objects with the format '[pile quantity]', e.g. '[0 3]'.
- Whoever takes the last object(s) wins!

invalid_move.wrong_format: No valid move format found. Use '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Player {player_id}, Invalid action. Column {col} is out of bounds.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Pile index {pile_index} is out of range.
